Identify in-memory only loaders and exploit code that adapt to OS version and do not write artifacts to disk. Flag use of NtQuerySystemInformation and SYSTEM_HANDLE queries by non-system processes. Watch for anti-VM and anti-analysis routines, such as checks for VM drivers or sandbox artifacts. Correlate RAR archive downloads from Discord with subsequent suspicious process activity, including network connections and privilege escalation attempts.
